responsibility: Record, query, export, retain and mirror typed instance-local audit evidence with caller-owned transaction atomicity and tamper-evident ordering.
nonResponsibilities: authentication, authorization decisions and product mutations
database administrator or operating-system activity auditing
telemetry durability and archive object storage
runtimeDependencies: an optional consumer-provided ArchiveSink for archive-required retention classes
an optional OpenTelemetry Logs implementation for the otelmirror adapter
